correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed every quantified step for real n>=3,t>0. Averaging arbitrary positive definite ellipsoid pullback Q under signed permutations preserves comparison and forces scalar I, so Euclidean coordinates are BM optimal. On Euclidean sphere, N_t² equals maximum over rank-two matrices e_i e_i^T+t eps eps^T with trace 1+nt, nonzero eigenvalue product t(n−1), giving L_n(t) and one-spike eigenvector. For minimum, normalize ||x||infinity=1, fixed ℓ1 mass s=k+theta transfers maximize ||x||2² at k ones and one theta; lower H_k=(1+t(k+theta)²)/(k+theta²) has derivative sign tk(k+theta)(1−theta)−theta, strictly decreasing from positive to negative, so minimum at integer endpoints 1/k+kt. Supports switch at 1/[k(k+1)]. Universal tuning lower bound uses k=floor sqrt n, L>=max(1,nt) and m<=1/k+kt to yield d²>=kn/(n+k²); t=1/n gives L=1+1/sqrt n and m>=2/sqrt n, proving n^(-1/4) inf_t d→1/sqrt2. An independent 3600-sample/36-exact-witness check is only corroborative, not proof.
